_comment: Microsoft Fabric MCP server (@microsoft/fabric-mcp, github.com/microsoft/mcp) — VS Code format. The server authenticates via DefaultAzureCredential (your 'az login' session) and does NOT read a pasted token. Run 'az login' (Contributor+ on the workspace) before starting the server. IMPORTANT for multi-tenant Microsoft identities: AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS=AzureCliCredential + AZURE_TENANT_ID pin auth to your 'az login' session and Fabric tenant — without them DefaultAzureCredential's interactive-browser fallback signs in to your HOME tenant and lists the wrong workspaces (or 404s). Remove AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS if you use a managed identity / service principal instead. FABRIC_WORKSPACE_ID/FABRIC_TENANT_ID are informational. See labs/lab12.md.

inputs.description: Fabric workspace GUID (informational; the server authenticates via your 'az login' session)

fabric.description: Microsoft Fabric MCP — enumerate workspaces/lakehouses/tables and query OneLake from VS Code. Authenticates via your 'az login' session (DefaultAzureCredential).
